data.title: The Bowl of Plums
data.text:
Two houses broke before you breached Riverside dam. No. 14 Church Lane and the Pells’ house next door stayed intact. The note on the kitchen table was practical: plums in the bowl, get on the late train, do not organize it.

Gil Harrow wrote that the spillway was deferred in 2009 and 2016. The national inspectors called the dam satisfactory; the harbour needed dredging; the school roof leaked. He believed there was time. I have put his letter beside the kitchen note. One records what was postponed. The other tells someone what to carry, and what to leave behind.

The plums were in the bowl.
